hero.description: A.R. Sahel Energy Ltd is a leading energy company specializing in the import and export of petroleum and energy products across West Africa and the Sahel region.

about.title: Driving Energy Solutions Across the Sahel
about.description: Registered with the Corporate Affairs Commission (RC 8589712), A.R. Sahel Energy Ltd is headquartered in Sokoto, Nigeria. We are committed to ensuring reliable energy supply chains across West Africa, connecting markets and powering communities.
about.missionText: To be the most trusted and efficient energy trading partner in the Sahel region, delivering premium petroleum and energy products with unmatched reliability.
about.visionText: To transform energy accessibility across West Africa, creating sustainable supply networks that power economic growth and improve lives.
about.valuesText: Integrity, reliability, and excellence form the cornerstone of every transaction and relationship we build.

services.title: Comprehensive Energy Solutions
services.description: From petroleum import and export to energy product distribution, we offer end-to-end solutions for the energy sector.
services.service1Desc: Strategic sourcing and importation of high-quality petroleum products from global suppliers to meet regional demand.
services.service2Desc: Efficient export operations connecting Sahel region energy products to international markets worldwide.
services.service3Desc: Extensive distribution infrastructure ensuring timely delivery across Nigeria and neighboring countries.
services.service4Desc: End-to-end supply chain optimization for seamless energy product flow from source to destination.
services.service5Desc: Rigorous quality control standards ensuring every product meets international specifications and safety requirements.
services.service6Desc: Expert advisory on energy market trends, regulatory compliance, and strategic planning for energy businesses.

regions.title: Serving the Heart of Africa
regions.description: Our operations span across West Africa and the greater Sahel region, connecting energy markets and ensuring reliable supply chains.

contact.title: Let's Power Your Business
contact.description: Ready to discuss your energy needs? Reach out to us and let's explore how we can work together.

footer.companyDesc: A.R. Sahel Energy Ltd — Import & Export of Petroleum & Energy Products. Powering Africa's energy future from the heart of the Sahel.
